compiled_state.title: [test-onboarding-skill]: test_jekyll_git_clone_path fails — onboarding SKILL.md missing Phase 1.6b git clone section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Bug

test_jekyll_git_clone_path in tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh fails on main (pre-existing, confirmed via git stash).

## Observed
test_jekyll_git_clone_path checks that plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md contains:
- 'Phase 1.6b'
- 'git clone'
- 'captive'

None of these strings are present in the onboarding SKILL.md.

## Expected
The onboarding SKILL.md should have a Phase 1.6b section documenting git clone with safety checks (captive portal / network check).

## Impact
Test suite has a known failure on main. Tracked via RED marker in .test-index at brainstorm/SKILL.md entry.

comments.body: Investigated: test asserts Phase 1.6b/git clone/captive strings in onboarding/SKILL.md. RED-marker tolerates the failure today (.test-index brainstorm/SKILL.md line). Fix path is binary: (a) implement the Phase 1.6b feature with the expected behaviors, or (b) delete the test. (a) requires knowing the intended UX of a captive-portal/network-check before git clone — needs user spec. (b) requires confirming the feature was deprecated. Either resolution requires user input; skipping in autonomous batch.
